answer_1.quote: We model German number inflection using the sequence-to-sequence Encoder-Decoder architecture ... the ED model takes character-level representations of German nouns in their singular form as inputs ... and learns to produce the noun's inflected plural form

answer_2.quote: The model achieves 88.8% accuracy on the held-out test set (Table ). It performs best on /-(e)n/, the most frequent class

answer_4.quote: We collected both production and rating data on plural inflection for the 24 M95 nonce nouns through an online survey with 150 native German-speaking participants
answer_4.guideline: Survey respondents were first prompted to produce a plural-inflected form for each noun ... After producing plural forms for all nouns, they were prompted to rate the acceptability of each potential plural form for each noun on a 1-5 Likert scale
